_note: Machine-readable record of what the three graphs actually were set to. Human-readable version: ../README.md and ../docs/metrics.md. Local paths; ComfyUI is assumed to be already running.

conditions.gpu_note: Whether a local chat model was resident during a run is not assumed: each run record in ../docs/metrics/run_*.json stores the free VRAM reported by /system_stats right before that run. The five headless runs of 04.11 began with 10980, 4531, 1389, 841 and 165 MiB free.
conditions.seed_note: Fixed in all three graphs: KSampler widget (krea2_edit), LCSeed feeding the MOSS sampler, AUSBOSS_NODES_Seed (qwen). The stale seed still stored in the MOSS sampler widget is overridden by its link.
conditions.canvas_note: Canvas sizes differ between graphs and are recorded from the SAVED FILES, not from widgets: several size widgets are overridden by incoming links. Sizes as executed: krea2_edit 1024x576, moss_inpaint 1024x576 (its AspectRatioSimplifier ignores custom_width/height when an image is linked and resolution_source is off), qwenImage_inpaint a 1049x590 crop around the touched mask.

appearance_region.provenance: the layout box of node 105 of _api/moss_inpaint.api.json, i.e. a region a measured run really used; it is also the only region in which that graph is allowed to edit at all
appearance_region.status: PROVISIONAL - a leftover demo rectangle (its prompt text is 'a bright red quilted puffer jacket with a fur-lined hood'), 59.3% of the frame, sky/lawn/road included
appearance_region.measured_on: 1398210 px at 2048x1152, 349887 px at 1024x576; the same normalized region for every method whatever size its graph saved
appearance_region.replace_with: a hand-drawn facade polygon or a saved mask (qwen MaskByTouch can export one)

workflows.method: image-edit conditioning only, no control signal: the photo is the input and the task is stated in words

replay.determinism: NOT reproducible at a fixed seed: the same API graph and seed 20261103 wrote krea2_edit_00111.png and krea2_edit_00114.png, which differ (mean absolute difference 0.0139; 1.5% of pixels differ by more than 0.1). That difference is this method's noise floor.

workflows.result_prefix_note: Measurement nodes save as moss_inpaint_depth_*; the graph's own result nodes save under a date prefix into a subfolder, writing two files ~1 s apart: the 1024x576 render and a 2052x576 source+result stitch. Rows keep only the candidate whose aspect matches the depth map, and record the skipped candidates.
workflows.method: colour+depth control (MOSS) confined to layout boxes
workflows.control: depth (Depth Anything V2) + colour reference + bounding boxes

replay.determinism: Reproducible while the graph is frozen: two headless replays of _api/moss_inpaint.api.json wrote bit-identical files (Test_2026-11-04_00001_.png == _00005_.png). Says nothing about pressing Run in the UI - LCSeed makes a fresh seed per queued run unless set to a fixed mode.

workflows.result_prefix_note: Result node saves as qwen21_inpaint_NNNN.png while the measurement nodes save as qwen_inpaint_depth_*: two prefixes for one graph. Until that is unified the result is matched by save time and the row is flagged.
workflows.method: inpaint by a mask touched in the UI, result stitched back into the original pixels
workflows.canvas_as_executed: 1049x590 crop around the mask (nothing records the crop position, so those rows are not measurable against the source frame)

replay.why: MaskByTouch keeps its touched points as browser state, not in the exported graph, so a headless replay fails with 'Mask by Touch: the picks were made on another picture' (04.11 00:39, prompt 590dee99, status error after 2.37 s, no file written).
replay.fix: wire a SaveImage on the node's MASK output, then LoadImage+LoadMask in the API graph instead of touching the picture
